scenes.title: The alarm rings
lines: It is ten to five and the house is asleep.
Then the alarm rings. The day starts early today.
You sit up in bed and it is still dark.
The kitchen light comes on softly and waits for you.

scenes.title: Leaving
lines: The morning goes by and the house is up with you.
Then it is time to go. You open the front door.
On the wall by the door is a display.
You press “All lights off”.
The lights go out, room by room, all the way to the door.
You close the door behind you and need no second round.

scenes.title: Nobody home
lines: Now nobody is home and the energy use goes down with it.
Around noon it starts to snow and frost settles on the windows.
The floor heating comes on and keeps the house warm, with nobody home.

scenes.title: Coming home
lines: Around five you come home.
The door opens and the lights come on ahead of you.
You start cooking and the meter climbs, as it does.
The hall light switches itself off. Nobody had to remember it.

scenes.title: Evening comes
lines: Evening comes and everything goes off except the living room.
The lights there dim with the evening.
And the curtains close.
Lights nobody uses stay off. That can save some energy.

scenes.title: Night
lines: You go to bed and the last light goes out.
Everything is off, but the house keeps watch.
Water on the bathroom floor. The sensor sees it and lets you know.

labels.end_sub: All on the home network, no subscription
